His left hand holds a small tied paper scroll at his hip (the scroll stays close to his body, not over the board). The chalkboard surface must have ZERO text, ZERO Korean characters, ZERO chalk writing, ZERO numbers, ZERO marks, ZERO symbols. Flat 2D anime shading, crisp outlines, matching the provided style reference. 16:9 widescreen, 1920×1080.
